name: Fenn
role: Leader of the smugglers in the North Cove
voice: quiet, polite — grows quieter the more dangerous it gets
appearance: salt-crusted leather jacket, silver ring on his thumb
motivation: Finish the job without anyone dying — he is a smuggler, not a murderer, and that is his weak spot.
body:
## Knows

> [!secret] Knows the name of whoever hired him, but only gives it
> once his way out is secured.

## Relationships

- [[jorna]]: old acquaintance; he avoids her eyes
